title: Search results (yg find --json)
$comment: This schema describes exactly what this release of Yggdrasil writes: every mapping is closed and every enumeration lists only the values this release uses. Use it to check a producer. Do not use it to reject a document you read: under the family rule a later release may add a field or a value within /1, and a /1 reader ignores what it does not know (see family-contracts).

results.description: At most five results; empty when nothing matched or the graph is empty.

id.description: A node's path (a valid --node argument), a rule's id, or a file's path.

status.description: A rule's default status; null for anything else.

score.description: Relevance relative to the best match (1 for the top result).

next.description: The command that shows this result's context, or null for a rule (read its file).
